title: aquilegia ecalcarata subsp. micrantha
intro: Aquilegia ecalcarata subsp. micrantha, commonly known as a species of the columbine family, is a flowering plant. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may aid in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia ecalcarata subsp. micrantha involve its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and its antimicrobial properties may help in fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
